verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an SMTP relay endpoint or generated SMTP credentials for Mailgun. The cited sending material covers the REST API, SDKs, MCP and integrations, and the Domain Sending Keys are API keys limited to the /messages endpoints, which is an adjacent API control rather than SMTP. SMTP relay is a fair axis for an email delivery service, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send through a documented SMTP relay with generated credentials when my framework or legacy app can't call the REST API
